NVIDIA-JR2025964.title: Senior Software Engineer, Test Engineering
NVIDIA-JR2025964.description:
NVIDIA is at the forefront of groundbreaking advances in artificial intelligence, high-performance computing, and simulation. The company is widely recognized as one of the technology industry's most desirable employers. We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer to join the Test Engineering team for NVIDIA Driver Assistance Systems (NDAS). In this role, you will help build and scale simulation and validation pipelines for advanced driver assistance systems. Your work will span data mining, automated labeling, benchmarking, CI/CD infrastructure, AI-assisted workflows, and large-scale test automation. Close collaboration with machine learning engineers, software developers, and systems engineers shapes the tools, datasets, metrics, and processes needed to evaluate complex autonomous driving systems.
What you'll be doing:
Test Case Engineering: Design, curate, and maintain comprehensive test suites covering system requirements, edge cases, and failure modes across diverse road types, environmental conditions, and vehicle interactions.
Tooling and Metrics Development: Architect and implement scalable evaluation tools and metrics that support critical system testing, verification, and release decisions.
AI-Assisted Data Pipelines: Build ground-truth datasets for ADAS features and develop LLM- and VLM-powered auto-labeling solutions that accelerate and scale data annotation workflows.
Simulation and Validation Infrastructure: Develop and improve simulation, replay testing, benchmarking, and CI/CD pipelines for efficient, repeatable, and large-scale validation.
Process Scaling: Create and refine standard operating procedures, labeling guidelines, and quality-control mechanisms, enabling established workflows to scale across internal and external labeling teams.
Issue Triage and Resolution: Identify, reproduce, and debug system anomalies. Collaborate closely with cross-functional teams to determine root causes, drive timely resolution, and validate software fixes.
Test Execution and Analytics: Execute offline validation using internal test frameworks, analyze large and complex datasets, and produce reports with actionable insights that guide system improvements.
Safety and Compliance: Ensure validation activities follow applicable automotive safety standards, regulatory requirements, and industry best practices.
NVIDIA-JR2025964.requirements:
Master's degree or Ph.D. in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Robotics, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
6+ years of hands-on experience in software development, testing, validation, or quality engineering, ideally in autonomous driving, automotive systems, robotics, or another safety-critical domain.
Hands-on background in ADAS or autonomous driving systems, covering simulation, replay-based testing, and model-based development workflows.
Strong programming and scripting skills in Python, C++, and Shell.
Fluency with modern software testing practices, including unit, integration, system, and end-to-end testing.
Experience designing or maintaining automated testing, benchmarking, or CI/CD infrastructure.
Familiarity with modern AI technologies—including LLMs, VLMs, and AI agents—and a track record applying them to workflow automation, data labeling, or engineering productivity.
Strong analytical, debugging, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to work effectively across multiple engineering disciplines.
Ways to stand out from the crowd:
A strong automation mindset and a track record of building software, platforms, or internal tools that significantly improve engineering efficiency and scalability.
Hands-on work with data science methodologies, large-scale data analysis, and advanced SQL.
Direct experience developing or validating production ADAS or autonomous driving features.
Depth in LLM/VLM/agentic development frameworks.
Exposure to distributed data-processing systems, large-scale simulation infrastructure, or agentic AI workflows.
NVIDIA is committed to fostering a diverse work environment and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate in our hiring or employment practices on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, disability status, or any other characteristic protected by law.
We are home to some of the forward-thinking and dedicated people in the world. If you are creative, self-motivated, and passionate about building reliable systems at scale, we would love to hear from you.

NVIDIA-JR2023360.title: Senior Software Engineer- Networking and Virtualization
NVIDIA-JR2023360.description:
NVIDIA is seeking for an experienced Software Engineer with a strong background in networking and virtualization technologies. This full-time position requires close collaboration with other NVIDIA SW and SW architecture teams, pre-sale teams and different industry leading architecture and RnD teams to develop leading SW solutions and stack, to provide the full solution for
NVIDIA's superior Connect-X NICs and Bluefield DPUs
. The role requires a strong knowledge of server/Cloud networking and virtualization technologies and top SW development skills.
What you’ll be doing:
Working with NVIDIA top customers RnD, getting familiar with their applications and needs with NVIDIA Product.
Building cutting edge POC prototypes which later to be productize and delivered.
Closely work with NVIDIA various development and architecture teams and take major part of SW development.
NVIDIA-JR2023360.requirements:
Bachelor or above in Computer Science or computer engineering or related discipline.
5+ years of practical experience.
Strong C/C++ programming skills (user and/or kernel modes).
Experiences using C/C++, Python in Linux hands-on development.
Deep networking knowledge and familiar with protocols such as VLAN, GRE, VXLAN, MPLS, IPSEC, PSP, etc.
Experience with cloud-networking and virtualization technologies.
Strong design, coding, debugging and problem-solving skills.
Advantage – knowledge at RDMA, OvS, DPDK, SRIOV, VIRTIO, Storage, etc.
Advantage – System Arch knowledge, PCIe knowledge, system performance aspects.
Ways to stand out from the crowd:
Demonstrated ability to work in a cross-functional team environment.
Self-motivated, ability to work with little definition and supervision while multi-tasking and prioritizing across a number of projects and initiatives.

NVIDIA-JR2024853.title: Senior Software Test Developer, SDET - Robotics
NVIDIA-JR2024853.description:
NVIDIA is the engine of modern AI, and robotics is where AI meets the physical world. The Isaac robotics platform — spanning Isaac Sim, Isaac Lab, Isaac ROS, the foundation models behind Isaac GR00T, and the accelerated libraries that run on Jetson and in the data center — is how the world’s developers and industrial leaders build intelligent robots.
We are seeking a dedicated and highly skilled Senior SWQA Test Developer to join our Isaac QA team in China. This role sits at the intersection of Isaac platform quality and the China robotics ecosystem. You will own China-specific validation across
Isaac
products — covering robot hardware platforms and partner integrations that are unique to the China market. You will also own the full lifecycle of robot hardware bring-up testing, factory software validation, and the Robot Platform Certification program for NVIDIA's Chinese partner companies.
Experience using AI tools to automate end-to-end QA workflows is essential. Familiarity with developing, automating, or demonstrating sophisticated AI agents and workflows is also highly desirable. This position requires frequent collaboration with Engineering and QA teams globally (India, US) as well as local Chinese robot OEM and partner teams. Join us at the forefront of the robotics and AI revolution and help shape the future of intelligent systems. Learn more at:
https://www.nvidia.com/en-in/industries/robotics/
What you'll be doing:
​
Apply AI-assisted tooling (LLM-based test generation, copilots, agent frameworks) to accelerate test authoring, failure triage, and coverage analysis
Develop test strategy, detailed test plans, and structured test cases based on product requirements and partner use cases
Validate full-stack behavior across local partner integrations and China-specific deployment environments
Lead bring-up testing for new robot hardware platforms entering production; define and execute factory software test plans covering functional verification, calibration, diagnostics, and manufacturing acceptance criteria
Execute end-to-end testing of GR00T-based robot action policies on China-available robot hardware; validate policy rollout, sim-to-real transfer fidelity, teleoperation data quality
Support data collection and maintain robot learning infrastructure; build dashboards and automation to track test coverage, fleet health, and data pipeline quality across robot deployments
Identify, record, document, and regress internal and external bugs; provide root cause analysis and statistical quality reports to global and local stakeholders
Collaborate with Engineering and QA teams globally (India, US) as well as local Chinese robot OEM and partner teams
Manage fleet of robots in Lab including hardware and software updates
NVIDIA-JR2024853.requirements:
Masters. in Engineering or Equivalent degree in CS/CE/IT/ECE/EEE
3 to 5 plus years of hands-on software QA or test engineering experience across an embedded or robotics software stack
Excellent programming skills with Python and/or C/C++ and able to write logical scripts/code from scratch
Solid Linux fundamentals: shell scripting, system debugging, process and network tools
Good knowledge in areas of Robotics perception, navigation, manipulation and simulation
Knowledge of robotics simulator engine and ability to develop automated test scenarios using the same
Experience using AI-assisted development tools (Copilot, Cursor, LLM-based agents) for test generation or QA workflow automation
Ability to engage effectively with Chinese robot OEM and partner engineering teams; strong written and verbal communication in both Chinese and English
Hands on experience with functional safety standards (ISO 26262), particularly in autonomous systems.
Passion for debugging complex failures and driving issues to root cause
Ways to stand out from the crowd:
Experience with Chinese robot platforms (humanoids, AMRs, manipulation arms) and familiarity with China-market robot OEM ecosystems
AI/ML degree, certification, or demonstrable project work in reinforcement learning, sim-to-real transfer, or robot learning
Experience optimizing test workflows using AI tools
Experience writing or evaluating robot foundation model inference pipelines (e.g., GR00T-based policies)
Contributions to open-source robotics projects or ROS community packages

NVIDIA-JR1993413.title: Senior Software and System Architect
NVIDIA-JR1993413.description:
Nvidia is looking for an outstanding passionate and talented Senior SW & System Architect to join our SW Architecture group.
The position includes researching new technologies with focus on architecture definition of groundbreaking technologies in different domains - networking, security, virtualization and orchestration.
NVIDIA Architecture group consists of world-class architects responsible for designing the next generation state-of-the-art architecture for our DPUs & NICs technologies.
You will play a key role defining the future of cloud solution stack, from HW to Application level, including orchestration, provisioning, network programmability and SDN.
You will be working with various teams around the world including SW architects, R&D, product, solution architects and external customers. This position offers a unique and exceptional opportunity to have real impact in a dynamic, technology-focused company shaping the future of data-centers technologies.
What you will be doing:
Lead architecture for cloud-networking including orchestration, provisioning and security solutions
Design state-of-the-art system architecture for DPUs & NICs technologies
Build end-to-end solutions from application level to HW
Responsible for writing effective, clear and reliable architecture specification
Evaluate new technologies and innovate & rapidly develop POC prototypes that can then be developed into full-fledged products/solutions
Work closely with different Nvidia teams around the world including sw & hw architects, R&D, product, solution architects, application and field engineers and more
Work with high profile customers on advanced and future technologies and solutions
NVIDIA-JR1993413.requirements:
B.Sc/M.Sc/Phd degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or Electrical Engineering
6+ years of experience as SW Architect/System Architect
4+ years of experience as SW developer
Deep knowledge and experience with C, Python
Hands on Linux development, Docker and Containers based technologies
Experience with cloud and Data Center networking
Wide knowledge and understanding of networking protocols and common network topologies
Strong design, coding, analytical, debugging and problem-solving skills
Ability to work concurrently with multiple groups locally and abroad in the organization
Excellent communication, documentation and presentation skills
Ways to stand out of a crowd:
Development experience with networking/security devices – NICs/DPUs/Switches/Routers /Firewalls etc.
Good understanding of OSs and drivers
Experience with DPDK, OVS, OVN
Experience with Kubernetes components & subsystems, CRDs, Operators, system plugins and CNI plugin development (Calico, Flannel)
Experience with OpenStack/OpenShift and/or Cloud APIs

NVIDIA-JR2022202.title: Senior Switch Software Architect
NVIDIA-JR2022202.description:
NVIDIA is building state-of-the-art accelerated computing platforms that know no boundaries. Our technology is essential for global innovators, scientists, researchers, and engineers empowering them to transform their boldest concepts into tangible outcomes. Our next-generation Infiniband, NVLink, and Ethernet systems will continue to be at the forefront of connecting and powering the world's most advanced AI clusters.
We seek a highly motivated and experienced
Senior
Software Architect specializing in Ethernet Switch ASICs
software to join our team of experts and help shape the future of high-performance ML/AI computing. You will have the opportunity to work on some of the most pioneering technologies and help drive the innovation of our next-generation networks. You will play a key role in defining switching software stacks and Linux kernel networking, and help address new business opportunities in exciting areas.
Our Architects represent NVIDIA in open-source projects, technical conferences, standard development organizations and lead customer engagements.
What you'll be doing:
Explore networking technologies, features and protocols, hardware/software capabilities, open-source software and drivers to build and enhance Networking platforms.
Identify and evaluate new technologies, innovations, initiatives, and software partners that align with our technology roadmap and business needs.
Define robust architectures and technical requirements for embedded software, meeting AI/ML workloads' needs and highly performing network operations.
Lead the work with R&D and Validation teams, providing technical guidelines and close support and thorough reviews for detailed designs and test plans.
Be a member of a team that defines the next-gen Switch.
Tight collaboration with architects across various fields, including Chip Design, Firmware, Hardware Platforms, and System teams.
Close work with product marketing, program managers, and account managers to ensure the successful execution of projects.
Lead engagements with key customers in pioneering edge-technology field.
Issue patents, publish white papers and blogs, and be proactive in technical forums and industry working groups.
Promote innovation through the design and implementation of Proof-of-Concept (PoC).
NVIDIA-JR2022202.requirements:
B.Sc. or M.Sc. in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or Electrical Engineering.
12+ years of experience in embedded software development for networking products, including 5+ years functioning as a Software Architect responsible for significant modules.
Expert-level knowledge in Ethernet/IP technologies, network topologies, and networking features in data center, telco and/or edge networks.
Highly experienced in embedded software design and operating system fundamentals.
Proven track record of proactively researching and integrating emerging technologies to develop practical applications and innovative solutions.
Leadership skills and accountability, including of past projects.
Clear verbal and written communication with the ability to build consensus within a large organization.
Possess problem-solving and critical thinking skills.
Ability to operate in a highly dynamic environment.
Professional level in English and local language.
Ways to stand out of the crowd:
Wide knowledge in Switch ASIC hardware, Software Development Kit (SDK), Network operating systems (NOS)
Deep understanding of the Linux kernel and networking.
Ability to prototype ideas, demonstrate their value, create initial implementations

NVIDIA-JR2029833.title: Senior System Design Engineer
NVIDIA-JR2029833.description:
NVIDIA has continuously reinvented itself over two decades. Our invention of the GPU in 1999 sparked the growth of the PC gaming market, redefined modern computer graphics, and revolutionized parallel computing. More recently, GPU deep learning ignited modern AI — the next era of computing. NVIDIA is a “learning machine” that constantly evolves by adapting to new challenges that are hard to tackle, that only we can pursue, and that matter to the world. This is our life’s work, to amplify human creativity and intelligence. We are now looking for a System Design Engineer in the System Product Team. In this role, you will be working with peer system design engineers to develop NVIDIA GPU/Tegra based products for GPU cards, MGX servers, automotive, robotics, industrial PC, consumer electronics, etc.
What You'll be Doing:
Review board designs and collaborate with other design engineers on product solutions.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to pursue the balance of product cost, performance, and schedule under the guidance of system architects and product architects.
Participate in the documentation required to release the product to manufactures and partners.
Optimize/invent circuits, functions for better performance, and lower cost.
Improve the design flow together with the infrastructure team.
NVIDIA-JR2029833.requirements:
B.S or M.S. in Electrical Engineering or equivalent experience.
10+ years of proven board design experience.
Strong analytical skills including past experience in PCB design and review.
Experience with using lab tools such as oscilloscopes, multimeters, and logic analyzers.
Comfortable working in various Linux environments as well as with Windows OS’s
Strong verbal and written skills.

NVIDIA-JR2029488.description:
NVIDIA is leading the way in groundbreaking developments in Artificial Intelligence, High-Performance Computing and Visualization. The GPU, our invention, serves as the visual cortex of modern computers and is at the heart of our products and services. Our work opens up new universes to explore, enables amazing creativity and discovery, and powers what were once science fiction inventions from artificial intelligence to autonomous cars. NVIDIA is looking for phenomenal people like you to help us accelerate the next wave of artificial intelligence.
We are looking for a highly motivated software engineer intern for an exciting role in our communication libraries and network software team. The position will be part of a fast-paced crew that develops and maintains software for complex heterogeneous computing systems that power disruptive products in High Performance Computing and Deep Learning.

Design, implement and maintain highly-optimized communication runtimes for Deep Learning frameworks (e.g. NCCL for TensorFlow/Pytorch) and HPC programming interfaces (e.g. UCX for MPI/OpenSHMEM) on GPU clusters.

Creating proof-of-concepts to evaluate and motivate extensions in programming models, new designs in runtimes and new features in hardware.

Ability and flexibility to work and communicate effectively in a multi-national, multi-time-zone corporate environment.

Deep knowledge of high-performance networks like InfiniBand, RoCE etc.
Background with HPC applications. Experience with Deep Learning Frameworks such PyTorch, TensorFlow, JAX/XLA, vLLM/SGLang etc.
Experience with AI/DL communication patterns such as Expert Parallelism (EP), TP, DP, PP and how these patterns can be implemented with NCCL. Experience with CUDA kernel optimization and profiling.

NVIDIA-JR2029925.title: Software Engineering Intern, Neural Reconstruction and Rendering - 2027
NVIDIA-JR2029925.description:
Join NVIDIA’s Real2Sim team to turn real-world captures into accurate, editable simulation environments for robotics. You will develop and evaluate reconstruction and rendering methods that improve scene geometry, visual fidelity, and computational efficiency, contributing to workflows built around NVIDIA NuRec and Isaac Sim.
What you’ll be doing
Improve neural scene reconstruction through Gaussian optimization, sampling, and geometry-aware learning, addressing incomplete surfaces, artifacts, and challenging viewpoints.
Explore surface extraction, material estimation, relighting, and generative refinement to make reconstructed environments more accurate and editable.
Implement and optimize research methods in reusable reconstruction and rendering pipelines, collaborating with engineers to integrate results into NuRec and Isaac Sim workflows.
Build reproducible experiments that measure geometric accuracy, novel-view quality, consistency across views and time, runtime, and GPU memory, and evaluate the impact on a selected robotics simulation use case.
NVIDIA-JR2029925.requirements:
Pursuing a master’s or doctoral degree in computer science, computer graphics, computer vision, robotics, or a related field.
Strong Python and PyTorch skills, with experience implementing, training, and debugging research models on GPUs.
Hands-on research or project experience in 3D Gaussian Splatting, neural rendering, multi-view reconstruction, or closely related methods.
Solid foundations in 3D geometry, camera models, numerical optimization, and machine learning.
Ability to reproduce research results, design controlled comparisons, analyze failure cases, and collaborate effectively with researchers and engineers.
Ways to stand out from the crowd
Depth in Gaussian sampling and densification, including MCMC-based optimization; surface reconstruction and meshing; or inverse rendering and relighting.
Experience with generative priors for reconstruction, scene completion, or rendering, including preserving geometry and consistency across views.
Experience with C++, CUDA, Slang, differentiable rendering, or GPU performance profiling.
Familiarity with gsplat, 3DGUT/3DGRT, NuRec, OpenUSD, or Isaac Sim; effective use of AI-assisted development with code review and validation.

NVIDIA-JR2029832.title: System Design Engineer
NVIDIA-JR2029832.description:
NVIDIA has continuously reinvented itself over two decades. Our invention of the GPU in 1999 sparked the growth of the PC gaming market, redefined modern computer graphics, and revolutionized parallel computing. More recently, GPU deep learning ignited modern AI — the next era of computing. NVIDIA is a “learning machine” that constantly evolves by adapting to new challenges that are hard to tackle, that only we can pursue, and that matter to the world. This is our life’s work, to amplify human creativity and intelligence. We are now looking for a System Design Engineer in the System Product Team. In this role, you will be working with peer system design engineers to develop NVIDIA GPU/Tegra based products for GPU cards, MGX servers, automotive, robotics, industrial PC, consumer electronics, etc.
What You'll be Doing:
Review board designs and collaborate with other design engineers on product solutions.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to pursue the balance of product cost, performance, and schedule under the guidance of system architects and product architects.
Participate in the documentation required to release the product to manufactures and partners.
Optimize/invent circuits, functions for better performance, and lower cost.
Improve the design flow together with the infrastructure team.
NVIDIA-JR2029832.requirements:
B.S in Electrical Engineering or equivalent experience.
1+ years of proven board design experience.
Strong analytical skills including past experience in PCB design and review.
Experience with using lab tools such as oscilloscopes, multimeters, and logic analyzers.
Comfortable working in various Linux environments as well as with Windows OS’s
Strong verbal and written skills.

NVIDIA-JR2028135.title: System Software Engineer Intern - Autonomous Vehicles – 2027
NVIDIA-JR2028135.description:
NVIDIA’s Autonomous Vehicles team builds the software platform that brings assisted and autonomous driving to production vehicles. The team works across the vehicle stack, from on-vehicle system software to the tools and infrastructure used to develop, update, secure, and operate that software at fleet scale. Engineers collaborate with internal product teams and automakers to turn new capabilities into reliable and secure software for production vehicles.
We are looking for a System Software Engineer Intern to contribute to in-vehicle system software. The work includes data collection, software updates, diagnostics, connectivity, and cybersecurity, along with AI-assisted tools that help engineers work with vehicle data. You will participate in design, implementation, testing, and debugging with guidance from experienced engineers.
NVIDIA is a “learning machine” that continuously evolves by tackling important problems that are difficult to solve. We are widely recognized as one of the technology industry’s most desirable employers. If you are curious, self-motivated, and enjoy building reliable software, we would love to hear from you.
What you’ll be doing
Implement and test in-vehicle system software, primarily in C/C++.
Help improve the reliability, performance, and security of software that runs on the vehicle and exchanges data with NVIDIA systems.
Contribute to tools that help engineers develop, debug, validate, and operate that software, including AI-assisted tools.
Integrate software on vehicle platforms and help reproduce and debug issues with global engineering teams.
Document designs, test results, and findings from technical investigations.
NVIDIA-JR2028135.requirements:
Currently pursuing a BS or MS or equivalent experience in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Cybersecurity, or a related field.
Strong C or C++ programming skills.
Familiarity with operating systems, networking, and data structures.
Understanding of fundamental software security concepts.
Ability to debug unfamiliar code and build working prototypes.
Clear communication skills and the ability to collaborate with an international team.
Ways to stand out from the crowd
Experience with data processing, telemetry, or software update systems.
Experience with AI-assisted developer tools, machine learning, language models, or agentic systems.
Coursework or projects involving embedded systems, Linux, networking, cybersecurity, or applied AI.
Experience with messaging systems.
Interest in automotive software, robotics, or autonomous systems.

NVIDIA-JR2028172.title: System Software Engineer Intern, Autonomous Vehicles - 2027
NVIDIA-JR2028172.description:
NVIDIA is the engine of the AI era. We invented the GPU, and the accelerated computing it made possible now powers the world's most advanced AI, from the data center to the car. Today, NVIDIA DRIVE brings that intelligence to the road: a full-stack platform that lets vehicles perceive, reason and act in the real world. We are looking to grow our teams with the smartest people in the world, and there has never been a more exciting time to join us.
The Autonomous Vehicles team develops and ships NVIDIA's DRIVE software platform. Our AV Stability group owns the reliability of the full stack on real vehicles: every issue found on a test drive flows through us before it reaches the owning team. You will reproduce, investigate and help fix the problems that stand between a prototype and a product, working with sensor, perception, planning and platform teams across the globe. As AI reshapes how engineering itself is done, our team is also where that change meets the vehicle: we increasingly build intelligent tooling on top of the same expertise we use to debug the car. We have real customers and real competition, and the work is exciting, fun, and very meaningful.
What you'll be doing:
Use in-house data playback, simulation, and visualization tools to re-animate and reproduce performance issues experienced during test drives.
Collaborate with software and algorithm experts to investigate, deduce, and isolate root causes of test drive issues, and to develop fixes and improvements.
Design and implement Autonomous Vehicles software, including system integration, application design, performance/power optimization, and stress/stability/compliance testing.
Drive the reliability of the whole software system, including time sync, vehicle network, RADAR, LiDAR, and camera sensor processing, and fusion.
Help turn hard-won debugging expertise into tooling and automation, including AI-assisted analysis of logs and vehicle data, so that problems are found faster and recur less.
Develop a strong technical understanding of the stack, and proactively identify new opportunities and creative ways to solve or mitigate technical challenges.
NVIDIA-JR2028172.requirements:
Pursuing a BS or MS in CS/CE/EE/Robotics or a related field.
Demonstrated proficiency in both C/C++ and Python: C/C++ to understand and debug the vehicle software stack, Python to build the tooling around it.
Strong debugging instincts: you can read logs and traces, form a hypothesis, and prove or disprove it with evidence.
Ability of using modern AI coding assistants as part of your everyday workflow, while verifying what they produce.
Familiar with git or other version control tooling.
Ability and flexibility to work and communicate effectively in a multinational, multi-time-zone environment.
Self-motivated and a good teammate.
Ways to stand out from the crowd:
Good knowledge of key Autonomous Driving technologies and the typical challenges of key components; prior experience in the AV field.
Worked with CAN and related tools, RADAR, LiDAR.
Hands-on experience with LLM-based tooling: prompt and context design, tool calling, agent workflows, or evaluation of model output on a real task.
Experience with large-scale log analysis and cloud-based workflows.

NVIDIA-JR2029368.title: ASIC Design Engineer, Clocks
NVIDIA-JR2029368.description:
The NVIDIA GPU clocks group is looking for an excellent Senior ASIC Design Engineer to join the team. The Team is responsible for crafting all aspects of GPU clocking. We collaborate with the frontend design team to understand the clocking requirements for the chip, and work with backend teams to understand the physical restrictions. The GPU clocks group architects, designs and validates the clocks RTL. The complexity of clocks RTL has increased many fold to support our features that power our product lines ranging from consumer graphics to self-driving cars and the growing field of artificial intelligence.
What you’ll be doing:
As a Clocks team member, you will collaborate with other architects, ASIC designers and verification engineers to design high frequency and low power clocks. You should be able to engage with multiple teams and design the GPU clocks to satisfy all the architectural constraints. You will need to run and enhance some in-house flow to guarantee the good quality of clocks RTL and netlist, drive the issues to close. Together with other team members, we deliver clock information to SOC verification team, timing and DFT teams. You will use Perl/Python to improve the productivity of the above teams. Collaborate with software and silicon solution team to debug GPU clock silicon bugs in our new products.
NVIDIA-JR2029368.requirements:
BS or (MS preferred) in EE or equivalent experience. 2+ years of meaningful work experience.
Your ability to thrive in a dynamically changing environment.
Validated experience in RTL design (Verilog), verification and logic synthesis. Your strong coding skills in Perl or Python or other industry-standard scripting languages.
Deep understanding of sub-micron silicon issues like noise, cross-talk, and OCV effects is a plus. Good understanding of backend flows and requirements is a plus.
DFT knowledge is a plus. Experience in implementing on-chip clocking networks is desirable.
Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills. Fluent English (both written and spoken) and excellent communication skills.
Good team work spirit, easy to cooperate with team members.

NVIDIA-JR2024860.title: ASIC Design and Verification Intern, SOC - 2027
NVIDIA-JR2024860.description:
The NVIDIA SOC group is looking for ASIC Design and Verification Interns to join the SysASIC and Clock teams. In this position, you will participate in the design and verification of complex reset/fuse/ism/sysctrl/boot and clock-related logic for latest NVIDIA products. You will work closely with global teams across Architecture, ASIC Design, Verification, DFT, Physical Design, Firmware, and Software.
What You’ll Be Doing:
Participate in RTL design and verification of SysASIC and clock-related IPs
Develop and debug Verilog/SystemVerilog RTL, testbenches, assertions, and simulation regressions.
Analyze and resolve issues from simulation, formal verification, lint, CDC/RDC, synthesis, STA, and gate-level verification.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to improve design quality, verification coverage, and development efficiency.
Develop scripts, automation tools and AI agent to improve design and verification flows.
NVIDIA-JR2024860.requirements:
Pursuing a BS/MS degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field.
Understanding of digital logic design and front-end ASIC development flow, including RTL design, simulation, synthesis, STA, lint, and CDC/RDC.
Familiarity with clocking concepts, such as clock gating, clock-domain crossing, reset synchronization, PLLs, and timing fundamentals.
Proficiency in Verilog and/or SystemVerilog; knowledge of UVM, SVA, or functional coverage is a plus.
Familiarity with formal verification concepts and tools, including property specification, assertion-based verification (SVA), equivalence checking, or formal property verification
Experience with Python, Perl, Tcl, shell scripting, C, or C++ is preferred.
Familiarity with Linux development environments and common EDA tools.
Strong analytical and debugging skills, attention to detail, and willingness to learn.
Good English communication skills and the ability to work effectively in a global team.

NVIDIA-JR2026524.title: Manager, Silicon Circuit and Power Integrity - Silicon Co-Design Group
NVIDIA-JR2026524.description:
NVIDIA's most critical silicon features — the circuits that catch failures before they propagate, extend silicon lifetime under the hardest workloads, hold their margins across every voltage and temperature corner, and stay clean in the presence of the noise and transient currents that real silicon at scale generates — these are the circuits that determine whether a product earns long-term trust in the field. They don't validate themselves. They require a team that thinks like circuit designers, works like experimentalists, and moves with the urgency of a production program. This role leads that team.
The Silicon Co-Design Group owns the boundary between design intent and silicon reality. As the manager of the Circuit Co-Design function, you own the people, the methodology, and the outcomes. You are not a coordinator. You are the technical and organizational force that ensures this team closes the hardest problems, ships with confidence, and gets better with every program.
What you'll be doing:
Lead a team of senior engineers across silicon bring-up, post-silicon validation, and circuit co-design for NVIDIA's safety, reliability, and performance enhancement features — including the noise, dI/dt, and power integrity challenges that determine whether those features hold under real operating conditions across the full PVT space and product lifetime.
Set technical direction. Define how the team characterizes circuits, closes simulation-to-silicon gaps, quantifies noise and dI/dt margins, analyzes aging and reliability mechanisms, triages failures, and drives fixes to confirmation. Your methodology is what scales across programs and generations.
Own the hard calls. When a reliability circuit isn't holding its margin, when a dI/dt transient is coupling into a sensitive feature, when substrate or supply noise is the hidden variable behind a failure that looks like something else, when a production program is at risk — you are in the room, and your judgment is what the organization acts on.
Hire and develop outstanding engineers. Build a team with depth in circuit co-design, power integrity, noise characterization, reliability physics, and post-silicon validation. Make the people around you measurably better.
Drive cross-functional alignment. Your team sits at the intersection of circuit design, architecture, VLSI, PDN, reliability engineering, firmware, and product. You ensure that intersection produces decisions, not delays.
NVIDIA-JR2026524.requirements:
BS or MS in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or equivalent.
10+ overall years in silicon validation, circuit co-design, or post-silicon characterization, with at least 3 years leading technical teams.
Deep circuit fundamentals — analog, digital, mixed-signal — with genuine expertise in power integrity, noise analysis, dI/dt characterization, and reliability and aging mechanisms. Deep enough to earn the respect of the engineers you lead and challenge the conclusions they bring you.
Hands-on background with substrate and supply noise analysis, PDN design and mitigation, and silicon reliability mechanisms — the intuition to know when a circuit failure is a circuit problem and when noise, aging, or a power transient is wearing a circuit's clothes.
A track record of hiring strong engineers, developing them into recognized experts, and retaining them.
The ability to hold technical depth and organizational breadth simultaneously — never losing the thread on a critical silicon reliability issue while managing a team across multiple programs.
Ways to stand out from the crowd:
Built or scaled a circuit co-design or reliability characterization organization and can speak to what worked and what didn't.
Personally closed a production-critical failure where noise, dI/dt, aging, or a power integrity interaction was part of the answer — and driven it all the way through to resolution.
Driven adoption of AI-driven flows across a validation or co-design team and set the guardrails that made it safe to do so.

NVIDIA-JR2028280.title: Manufacturing Automation Solution Intern - 2027
NVIDIA-JR2028280.description:
We are excited to offer an outstanding opportunity for a Manufacturing Automation Solution Intern - 2027 to join our world-class team at NVIDIA! This role is perfect for an ambitious individual looking to make a significant impact in the field of industrial automation and Physical AI.
This role involves leading efforts in industrial automation and Physical AI with Omniverse by NVIDIA and OpenUSD frameworks. You will transform complex physical automation equipment, test cells, and robotic systems into accurate digital twins. You will collaborate with mechanical, test, and software groups to develop the future of industrial production based on Omniverse. If you are enthusiastic about 3D graphics, physics simulation, robotics, and bringing code to life with kinetic motion, this role is an excellent platform to begin your career.
What you will be doing:
Clean up, lightweight, and render industrial CAD models into the NVIDIA Omniverse platform, building standardized, high-fidelity OpenUSD 3D digital assets.
Define OpenUSD asset standards (scene hierarchy, PhysX materials, semantic schemas) for automated equipment in Omniverse, opening them to ecosystem partners to build a unified asset ecosystem.
Establish virtual testing and interference review standards in Omniverse; evaluate facility footprint and maintenance limits, directing vendors to deliver compliant scenes and equipment models within Omniverse.
Formulate simulation and Cycle Time (CT) demo examples and evaluation standards for axis/robotics in NVIDIA Isaac Sim / PhysX. This drives vendors to improve CT and remove efficiency bottlenecks virtually in Omniverse.
Define communication interface standards (OPC UA/Modbus) using Omniverse Python APIs. Connect the equipment software platform with controllers. Guide vendors to plug into Omniverse for Software-in-the-Loop (SIL) commissioning.
Build digital twin reference implementations by ingesting real-time sensor and machine telemetry data into NVIDIA Omniverse. Establish standardized technical frameworks and API guidelines to empower and guide vendors in replicating live 3D sync and supervising across their own equipment.
Fully bring to bear NVIDIA Omniverse technologies and ecosystem capabilities to translate Physical AI into real-world industrial efficiency, exploring emerging business models for digital twins in automation.
NVIDIA-JR2028280.requirements:
Currently pursuing a degree (BS or MS) in Computer Science, Automation, Robotics, Mechatronics, Software Engineering, or a related technical domain.
Strong Python programming skills (Required; ability to write clean, object-oriented scripts and APIs). Familiarity with Linux environments and common industrial communication protocols (e.g., OPC UA, Modbus, TCP/IP) is preferred.
Practical experience with at least one 3D simulation or game engine (e.g., NVIDIA Omniverse, Isaac Sim, Unreal Engine, Unity) or 3D CAD software (SolidWorks, Creo, NX, Blender, etc.).
Excellent analytical problem-solving skills; strong cross-functional communication approach to collaborate effectively with mechanical engineers, omniverse developers, and third-party equipment vendors.
Skilled in both Chinese and English, capable of independently guiding and engaging in technical business discussions in English.
Ways to stand out from the crowd:
Practical experience working directly with NVIDIA Omniverse and its essential ecosystem components, including Isaac Sim (robotics & automation simulation).
Familiarity with Pixar OpenUSD structures is a strong plus.
Familiarity with industrial control software or automation equipment software is preferred.
Practical project experience in software/hardware communication setup via OPC UA, Modbus-TCP, MQTT, or WebSockets; familiarity with Software-in-the-Loop (SIL) virtual commissioning workflows.
Strong engineering standardization approach with the ability to distill reference implementations from practical projects. Write structured API documentation and standard specifications. Empower external vendors and ecosystem partners.
Join us at NVIDIA and help build the future of industrial automation with innovative technology!

NVIDIA-JR2018293.title: Mechanical Solution Engineer, Robotics
NVIDIA-JR2018293.description:
We are seeking hands-on Mechanical Engineer in Solutions Architecture Team to support the design and development of robotic hardware systems, with a focus on mechanism design and mechatronics integration. This role will contribute to rapid prototyping, iteration, and validation of mechanical subsystems, particularly for end-effectors and robotic assemblies. You’ll collaborate with Gear Lab Team known for influential work in multimodal foundation models, large-scale robot learning, embodied
AI
, and
physics simulation
, pushing the frontier of
humanoid robotics
.
What you'll be doing:
Design and develop mechanical components and assemblies for robotic systems, with emphasis on mechanisms and transmissions
Contribute to end-effector and gripper design, including kinematics, packaging, and integration with actuators and sensors
Prototype and iterate designs using rapid fabrication methods (3D printing, off-the-shelf components, vendor-fabricated parts)
Collaborate with electrical and software engineers to integrate motors, sensors, and control systems
Perform basic analysis and validation of designs (tolerance, strength, failure modes, etc.)
Generate clear CAD models, drawings, and documentation for fabrication and assembly
Support lab build, test, and debugging of hardware systems
NVIDIA-JR2018293.requirements:
Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Mechanical Engineering or related field with over 4 years' working experience
Strong fundamentals in mechanical design, including mechanisms, linkages, gear trains, and actuation systems
Experience with robotic systems, mechatronics, or precision mechanical design
Proficiency in CAD (e.g., Onshape, SolidWorks, Fusion 360, or similar)
Familiarity with motors, transmissions, and basic control concepts
Understanding of design for manufacturing (DFM) and tolerance stack-up
Hands-on experience building and debugging physical hardware
Ways to stand out from the crowd:
Experience with end-effectors or gripper design
Familiarity with cable-driven systems, compliant mechanisms, or underactuated designs
Experience working with vendors for CNC, sheet metal, or additive manufacturing
Exposure to sensors (encoders, force/torque, tactile) and their integration
Basic programming or scripting for testing and data collection

NVIDIA-JR2024861.title: SOC Design Team Methodology Intern - 2027
NVIDIA-JR2024861.description:
The NVIDIA System-on-Chip (SOC) design group is looking for a motivated intern to join our Methodology team. In this role, you will help improve the way we design, configure, and verify in SOC Design fields— making them faster, more reliable, and increasingly AI-assisted.
This is a hands-on opportunity to work at the intersection of digital ASIC front-end methodology and applied AI. You will contribute to real production flows used across NVIDIA's SOC projects, partner with experienced engineers, and see how modern AI agents can accelerate chip design. We are looking for someone who is curious about finding problems, open-minded in solving them, quick to learn new tools, and detail-oriented in execution — while being organized, collaborative, and a strong communicator.
What You'll Be Doing:
Get up to speed on NVIDIA's SOC project development environment, tooling, and design flows.
Identify pain points in SOC configuration work and related methodology areas, and help scope opportunities for improvement.
Review conventional SOC design flows, document bottlenecks, and propose and prototype upgrades that improve turnaround time, quality, or automation.
Develop and refine AI agents and automation scripts to support "Speed of Light" execution — helping engineers move faster by reducing manual, repetitive steps.
Contribute to documentation, runbooks, and best-practice guides so that methodology improvements are repeatable and adoptable by the broader team.
Collaborate with SOC Design engineers to gather requirements, validate ideas, and iterate on solutions.
NVIDIA-JR2024861.requirements:
Currently pursuing a MS (or higher) Students in Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, who will graduate at 2028
Working knowledge of digital ASIC front-end design flows
Strong scripting skills — Python, Perl, or similar languages — with the ability to automate tasks and build maintainable tooling.
Genuine interest and foundational knowledge in AI agent development (e.g., LLM-based agents, prompt design, tool-use / function-calling, or agentic workflows).
Fluent English, both written and spoken, for effective collaboration in a global team.
Ways to Stand Out from the Crowd:
Coursework, projects, or internships in SOC design methodology.
Hands-on experience building or integrating AI agents (e.g., LangChain, LlamaIndex, OpenAI-style tool use, or similar frameworks).
Familiarity with version control (Git), CI/CD, and software engineering best practices.
Comfort working in a Linux development environment with large codebases and EDA toolchains.
A problem-finding mindset — you don't just solve assigned tasks, you proactively surface issues and propose improvements.
Strong communication and teamwork, with the ability to explain technical trade-offs clearly to both engineers and stakeholders.

NVIDIA-JR2029276.title: Senior ASIC Engineer
NVIDIA-JR2029276.description:
NVIDIA is seeking an ASIC Design Engineer to help develop advanced video IP for the world’s leading SoCs and GPUs. The NVIDIA MMPLEX Video team delivers video solutions across NVIDIA product lines, from consumer graphics and self-driving cars to the rapidly growing field of artificial intelligence. This position offers the opportunity to make a real impact in a multifaceted, technology-focused company, contributing to video codec designs from algorithm and architecture exploration through implementation and verification. You’ll join a globally distributed team of outstanding engineers working to push the frontiers of what is possible today and define the platform for the future of computing.
What you’ll be doing
Explore video algorithms and architectures across quality, performance, power, and area.
Define microarchitecture and implement verified HLS/RTL designs that meet PPA and timing goals.
Set verification and quality gates to confirm changes are correct and ready for integration.
Use AI where useful to speed ASIC work; validate outputs with engineering judgment.
Collaborate with architecture, design, verification, SoC, emulation, and implementation teams.

BS/MS in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related field.
3–5 years of ASIC design experience, contributing to chip or major IP delivery.

Ability to learn unfamiliar topics quickly and ask clear, thoughtful questions.
Ability to work independently and collaborate effectively across teams.

Deep HLS knowledge: algorithm modeling, scheduling, RTL generation, and PPA tradeoffs.

NVIDIA-JR2022211.title: Senior ASIC Verification Engineer - PMU
NVIDIA-JR2022211.description:
As chip sizes continue to grow, power efficiency has become critical across all NVIDIA products - from data centers to automotive and personal computing. Our PMU IP, developed over the past 17 years, is crucial in optimizing chip performance and efficiency in both idle and active scenarios. The PMU IP consists of a RISC-V core and custom-designed control logic. It collects and processes data from the entire chip, working in tandem with software running on the RISC-V core to determine optimal operating points. We are seeking a Senior ASIC Engineer who can help architect the next generation PMU for AI datacenter.
What you’ll be doing:
Collaborate with the production SW team and power arch team to define the architecture/micro-architecture for various power features.
Learn how PMU's function impacts the system and support the silicon debug.
Implement the micro-architecture to RTL design.
NVIDIA-JR2022211.requirements:
BS / MS in electrical / computer engineering.
3+ years working experience, with preference given to those with MS or equivalent experience.
Strong communication skills and proficient oral English since this role require frequent communication with external teams mainly in USA and India.
Familiar with frontend ASIC design.
Ways to stand out from the crowd:
Experience on active power/low power design.
Play similar role in other system-level control features if not power related.

NVIDIA-JR2027818.title: Senior Hardware System Engineer
NVIDIA-JR2027818.description:
We are looking for a system engineer to join our Failure Analysis engineering team under the System Product Engineering group in the NVIDIA. As a System Failure Analysis (FA) Engineer, you are responsible for the end-to-end investigation of product failures. You act as the Failure analysis product owner diagnosing complex issues that span Hardware, Software, Firmware, and Mechanical boundaries of the investigation, synthesizing data from all engineering disciplines to reach a definitive root cause. While you provide the architectural oversight for the team, you remain deeply technical and active in the laboratory environment.
​
What You’ll Be Doing:
​Hands-on Lab Investigation: You are active in the lab environment. You perform advanced debugging, characterize system behavior, run reproductions of failures in the lab, and utilize sophisticated lab equipment to validate hypotheses, bridging the gap between high-level data and physical hardware reality.
Multidisciplinary Failure Analysis: Lead deep-dive investigations into system-level failures, understand and analyse customer usage for the product, diagnose how software execution, firmware logic, and hardware components interact to cause specific failure modes.
​Root Cause Ownership: Drive the investigation lifecycle from initial symptom to final physics-of-failure or logic-error identification.
​Task Force Leadership: Orchestrate and lead cross-organizational technical task forces at the company level. You align experts from HW, SW, Mechanical, and NPI teams to solve high-priority technical problems.
​Advanced Data & AI Integration: Define and utilize sophisticated data analysis tools and AI-driven methodologies. You correlate customer failure patterns with production telemetry and RMA history to identify hidden trends and systemic risks.
​Customer Quality Support: Take part in the customer interface by interacting with NVIDIA’s Customer Quality Engineers. You provide the deep technical evidence and root-cause clarity needed for quality reports and high-level technical presentations.
​Strategic Lab Direction: Define the high-level debug strategy and complex test plans for the lab. You guide hardware practical engineers on characterization requirements and system-level stress testing.​
NVIDIA-JR2027818.requirements:
​​Lab Proficiency: Expert-level experience with lab equipment and the ability to conduct complex characterization on state-of-the-art hardware.
System Engineering Depth: B.Sc/B.Tech in Electrical Engineering, or a related technical field.
​Product Development Experience: 5+ years of experience in Product Development, System-Level Debugging, or Architecture. You must understand how a product is designed and manufactured to effectively analyze its failure.
​Full-Stack Debugging Skills: Proven ability to troubleshoot issues where the hardware, software, and firmware interface. You are comfortable navigating different technical domains to find a root cause.
​Data Fluency: Experience using data analysis tools and a strong interest in applying AI/Machine Learning to automate and scale failure analysis processes.
​Leadership Presence: The ability to lead technical teams through high-pressure investigations and clearly communicate findings to both engineering and quality stakeholders.
​
Ways to Stand Out from the crowd:
​Hybrid Technical Background: Experience in Board Design combined with SW or Firmware development.
​NPI to Mass Production Expertise: A track record of solving technical problems during the transition from prototype to high-volume manufacturing.
​Data Tooling: Experience building custom Python scripts or SQL dashboards to visualize and analyze global product failure distributions.
​Failure Avoidance Mindset: Ability to provide technical feedback to R&D teams based on FA findings to improve the robustness of future products.
NVIDIA is widely considered to be one of the technology world’s most desirable employers. We have some of the most forward-thinking and hardworking people on the planet working for us. If you're creative and autonomous, we want to hear from you! NVIDIA is committed to fostering a diverse work environment and proud to be an equal opportunity employer as we highly value diversity in our current and future employees.

NVIDIA-JR2020805.title: Senior Infrastructure Automation Engineer - Silicon Co-Design Group
NVIDIA-JR2020805.description:
NVIDIA's Silicon Co-Design Group is seeking a Senior Infrastructure Automation Engineer to innovate, develop, and integrate innovative AI solutions into the design and automation infrastructure that powers our chips. Every CPU, GPU, and Tegra SoC NVIDIA has shipped in the past four years passed through our toolchain on its way to production — over 200 product SKUs were optimized during the Blackwell generation alone. Now we're rebuilding that toolchain around AI, and we're looking for the engineer to lead that charge. In this role, you will architect and implement solutions that enhance the efficiency, scalability, and intelligence of our workflows, driving initiatives from concept to deployment. If you combine deep technical expertise with a hands-on approach and an aim to push the boundaries of what's possible, this is your opportunity. At NVIDIA, we strive for perfection, encourage innovation, and provide opportunities to explore new ways to succeed!
What you'll be doing:
Define clear vision and roadmap for productivity efficiency improvement solutions in alignment with business needs and drive execution from design through delivery.
Lead cross-function engineering teams on project deliverables commitment to streamline the system design and verification process and workflow. You own the pipelines between tools.
Build production-grade AI-assisted automation infrastructure for Silicon Co-Design use cases, including reliable orchestration, observability, evaluation, guardrails, and human-in-the-loop controls where needed.
Drive Cross-function Collaboration with ASIC, SW, System Design, Product, Security, and Operations teams to ensure reliability, scalability, and performance, fostering a culture of technical excellence, collaboration, and ownership.
Drive hard debugging and root-cause analysis across infrastructure, automation, data, and HW/SW boundary issues; separate competing hypotheses, define measurement plans, and converge teams on the right fix.
NVIDIA-JR2020805.requirements:
MS or PHD in EE or equivalent experience.
Strong software engineering background with 8+ years significant experience designing large-scale infrastructure, framework architecture, or developer platforms.
Strong proficiency in Python and at least one static language (C, C++, C#, Java, Scala, etc).
Hands-on experience in AI/ML and data analysis, preferably with exposure to large-scale datasets.
Strong EE fundamentals, including computer architecture, high-speed interfaces, timing, power basics, and a solid understanding of firmware/driver structures and hardware interaction.
Excellent problem-solving, communication, and collaboration skills.
Ability to break down ambiguous technical problems, explain failure modes and edge cases, and make strong tradeoff decisions under schedule, coverage, quality, and performance constraints.
Track record of independently driving complex, cross-functional work to closure with clear ownership and strong collaboration.
Ways to stand out from the crowd:
Hands-on experience with silicon bring-up, characterization, or lab debug using standard tools (e.g., oscilloscopes, multimeters, logic analyzers).
Experience on building production AI workflow systems for engineering or infrastructure use cases, not just prototypes.
Strong debugging instincts across distributed systems, automation pipelines, and HW/SW interactions, and can explain your hypothesis tree, measurement plan, tradeoffs, and final decision points.
Track record of AI Experience to accelerate coding, analysis, validation, or triage with strong engineering judgment and validation discipline
Widely considered to be one of the technology world’s most desirable employers, NVIDIA offers highly competitive salaries and a comprehensive benefits package. As you plan your future, see what we can offer to you and your family
www.nvidiabenefits.com/
​

NVIDIA-JR2028810.title: Senior Mechanical Engineer – Manufacturing & Supplier Engineering
NVIDIA-JR2028810.description:
We are looking for a
hands-on Mechanical Engineer to be the local representative of our mechanical engineering team in Israel across our manufacturing sites and mechanical suppliers in China
. You will be our mechanical expert on the ground, working directly with manufacturing partners and suppliers to address technical and manufacturing challenges and continuously improve the way our products are built.
You will own manufacturing challenges from identification through implementation of the solution, support the design and improvement of jigs and fixtures, drive manufacturing process improvements, and help optimize production lines for quality, efficiency, and scalability.
This role is ideal for a highly technical and creative engineer who enjoys working close to the hardware, tackling real-world manufacturing challenges, and thinking outside the box. You will act as a key bridge between our engineering teams in Israel and our manufacturing partners in China.
NVIDIA Networking division
is a leading supplier of innovative end-to-end InfiniBand and Ethernet connectivity solutions and services for servers and storage. We offer market-leading solutions that include adapter cards, switches, cables, and software to support networking technologies. Our products optimize data center performance and deliver industry-leading bandwidth and scalability. In addition, we serve a wide range of sectors including high-performance computing, enterprise, data centers, cloud computing and Web 2.0. We are constantly reinventing ourselves to stay ahead of the market and bring groundbreaking products and services to the industry. Our product line is focused on delivering the most optimized Ethernet and optical solutions for industries that can benefit from accelerated networking at scale.
What you'll be doing:
Acting as the on-site mechanical point of contact representing NVIDIA Israel's mechanical department across manufacturing sites and mechanical suppliers in China, owning the daily mechanical agenda across active programs.
Working closely with manufacturing partners and mechanical part suppliers to investigate and address mechanical and manufacturing challenges, including quality and yield-related topics.
Investigating manufacturing challenges, escalations and yield blockers on the production floor, applying structured root-cause methods such as fishbone and fault-tree analysis, with documented corrective actions.
Supporting the design, development, troubleshooting and improvement of manufacturing jigs and fixtures, working directly with suppliers and production teams to implement practical solutions on the line.
Driving manufacturing process improvements and production-line optimization, identifying opportunities to improve quality, efficiency, repeatability and scalability.
Leading technical investigations on builds, line returns and qualification samples, including inspection, microscopy, dimensional metrology, cross-section, contamination and assembly-process analysis.
Planning and running mechanical experiments and structured design-of-experiments on-site, aligning test plans with the Israel team, executing on the production floor, and reporting results back.
Supporting bring-ups, pilot runs, production builds and mass production, with hands-on presence on the manufacturing floor to make real-time mechanical decisions and capture build learnings.
NVIDIA-JR2028810.requirements:
Engineering diploma in Mechanical Engineering or equivalent experience.
8+ years of hands-on experience as a mechanical engineer in similar roles, such as datacom, server, networking, datacenter, or comparably complex electronic hardware products.
Hands-on experience working with contract manufacturers, original design manufacturers, and/or mechanical part suppliers in new product introduction, ramp or mass-production environments.
Strong technical capabilities and the ability to independently investigate and address complex mechanical and manufacturing challenges.
Track record leading technical investigations from initial findings through verified root cause and implementation of documented corrective actions.
Experience with manufacturing processes, production tooling, jigs and fixtures, including troubleshooting and improving existing manufacturing solutions.
Hands-on knowledge and experience with joining and brazing processes, including high-frequency brazing, oven brazing, soldering, welding, and related manufacturing processes.
Strong command of mechanical inspection and metrology, including geometric dimensioning and tolerancing, coordinate measuring machines, vision systems, gauges and dimensional analysis.
Ways to stand out from the crowd:
Prior on-site experience at a major contract manufacturer, ODM, or mechanical supplier in China or elsewhere in Asia.
Strong knowledge of mechanical manufacturing processes and experience working directly with part suppliers.
Experience designing, developing or improving manufacturing jigs, fixtures and production tooling.
Strong practical experience in brazing, soldering and welding processes, including process development, qualification and manufacturing troubleshooting.
Experience working in cleanroom environments.
NVIDIA is widely considered to be one of the technology world's most desirable employers.
We have some of the most forward-thinking and hardworking people in the world working for us. Are you a hands-on engineer who thrives next to the hardware and loves a challenge? Are you ready to become the engineer you always wanted to be? Come and be part of the best mechanical hardware team in the industry!
We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company.
We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodatio
n.
